patch.value: Port the parser-backed docstring gate into pm-vcs

pm-changelog enforces full docstring coverage with a gate that parses each file into a syntax tree, rejects a docstring that only restates its identifier, and walks its roots rather than reading a frozen file list. pm-vcs has none, so its docstring coverage is a convention rather than a gate. Porting it needs one extension: pm-vcs keeps six source files at the repository root alongside engine/ and scripts/, and the gate currently accepts only directories as roots, so a root-level file would go unscanned - which is the frozen-list failure the gate exists to prevent, arriving by a different door.

npm run docstring fails on an undocumented export anywhere under the repository's source roots including the root-level files; the gate refuses to pass when a configured root is missing or yields no files; the roots cannot silently stop covering a source file added later; release:check runs it
